result:
I wrote the review to `.social-review.md`. X, LinkedIn and Bluesky all pass. None breaks a hard rule, and all three are under their character limits (251/255, 666/2950, 199/300).

I didn't run the separate sub-agent critique or suggestions passes from SKILL.md. I checked the copy against the critique rubric myself and wrote the three advisory notes myself. I also didn't read the blog post, since the copy passed and nothing needed drafting.

The advisory notes are collapsed in the file and don't block anything:
- **X:** it covers the whole story, so it gives readers little reason to click.
- **LinkedIn:** the closing pointer is a table-of-contents line. A concrete hook would pull harder.
- **Bluesky:** it has no pointer to the article and nearly repeats the X copy.

I also added the "apply these suggestions" and "/social-review" lines that SKILL.md's CI section asks for at the end of the comment.
